heading: Determination in relation to an Aboriginal person
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 3A inserted by No. 70/2010 s. 5, amended by No. 26/2017 s. 14(1), substituted by No. 28/2023 s. 33.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "3A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 25, "rect": {"page": 25, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 238.6, "x1": 512.6, "y1": 332.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In making a determination under this Act in relation to an Aboriginal person, a bail decision maker must take into account (in addition to any other requirements of this Act) any issues that arise due to the person's Aboriginality, including the following—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the historical and ongoing discriminatory systemic factors that have resulted in Aboriginal people being over-represented in the criminal justice system, including in the remand population;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the risk of harm and trauma that being in custody poses to Aboriginal people;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the importance of maintaining and supporting the development of the person's connection to culture, kinship, family, Elders, country and community;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any issues that arise in relation to the person's history, culture or circumstances, including the following—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the impact of any experience of trauma and intergenerational trauma, including abuse, neglect, loss and family violence;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any experience of out of home care, including foster care and residential care;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any experience of social or economic disadvantage, including homelessness and unstable housing;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": "iv", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any ill health the person experiences, including mental illness;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": "v", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any disability the person has, including physical disability, intellectual disability and cognitive impairment;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": "vi", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any caring responsibilities the person has, including as the sole or primary parent of an Aboriginal child;

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: any other relevant cultural issue or obligation.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Aboriginal person is also a child, the bail decision maker must also take into account the issues set out in section 3B(1).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The bail decision maker is to take account of an issue set out in subsection (1) by reference to the evidence and information that is reasonably available to the bail decision maker at the time, including information provided by—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the Aboriginal person's family and community; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: providers of Aboriginal bail support services.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Despite subsection (2), the bail decision maker is to take account of the issues set out in subsection (1)(a) to (c) whether or not any evidence or information is before the bail decision maker in respect of those issues.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The requirement to take an issue set out in subsection (1) into account applies regardless of—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the person's connection to their Aboriginality and culture has been intermittent throughout their life; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether the person has only recently connected to or discovered their culture or heritage; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: when the person first discloses that they are an Aboriginal person.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a bail decision maker refuses bail to an Aboriginal person, the bail decision maker must—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: identify the matters the bail decision maker had regard to in taking into account the issues set out in subsection (1); and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: either—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: state those matters orally when refusing bail and ensure that an audio visual recording, or an audio recording, is made of that statement; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: record those matters in writing in a form that the bail decision maker considers appropriate.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 19(2) of the Charter of Human Rights and Responsibilities provides that Aboriginal persons hold distinct cultural rights and must not be denied the various rights referred to in that provision.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "1", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "3A", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: When considering bail for an Aboriginal person charged with a Commonwealth offence, a bail decision maker must comply with section 15AB(1)(b) of the Crimes Act 1914 of the Commonwealth.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 10(2) amended by No. 26/2017 s. 15(3).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "10", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 71, "rect": {"page": 71, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 509.2, "x1": 506.6, "y1": 548.3}, "confidence": "high"}]

text: A police officer of or above the rank of sergeant or for the time being in charge of a police station, the sheriff or a person authorised under section 115(5) of the Fines Reform Act 2014 (as the case requires) must, without delay, consider whether to grant bail to the person in accordance with this Act.

text: If the person is a child, the bail decision maker must ensure that a parent or guardian of the child, or an independent person, is present during the proceeding in relation to bail.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See also section 5AA (conditions of bail granted to a child in certain circumstances).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

text: If bail is refused under subsection (5) and the arrested person is not a person to whom section 10AA applies, the bail decision maker must—

text: If the person is brought before the bail justice because a police officer, on refusing bail for the person under section 10(5), was of the opinion that the person was an Aboriginal person or a vulnerable adult, the bail justice is not required to consider whether the person is such a person but may rely on the opinion of the police officer.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the person is a child, the bail justice must ensure that a parent or guardian of the child, or an independent person, is present during the hearing of the application.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: An independent person present in accordance with subsection (3) may take steps to facilitate the granting of bail, for example, by arranging accommodation.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 10A(5A) inserted by No. 3/2018 s. 15(3).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "10A", "sub_path": ["(5A)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 78, "rect": {"page": 78, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 601.1, "x1": 124.0, "y1": 640.2}, "confidence": "high"}]

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 10A(5A)(b) amended by No. 28/2023 s. 46.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "10A", "sub_path": ["(5A)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 78, "rect": {"page": 78, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 654.5, "x1": 130.6, "y1": 693.6}, "confidence": "high"}]

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 10A(5AA) inserted by No. 32/2018 s. 91(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "10A", "sub_path": ["(5AA)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 78, "rect": {"page": 78, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 364.9, "x1": 127.2, "y1": 404.1}, "confidence": "high"}]

text: If the bail justice is prohibited by subsection (5AA) or section 13, 13AA or 13A from granting bail to the person, the bail justice must refuse to consider whether to grant or refuse bail.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10A", "subsection": "5AAB", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Section 10B requires that the informant must bring the person before a court as soon as practicable.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 10AA(1) amended by No. 3/2018 s. 23(7).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "10AA", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 75, "rect": {"page": 75, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 278.2, "x1": 506.6, "y1": 317.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Subject to subsection (2), this section applies to any arrested person mentioned in section 10(1) and for whom bail is refused under section 10(5) by a bail decision maker who is a police officer of or above the rank of sergeant or for the time being in charge of a police station.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10AA", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section does not apply to an arrested person who is—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10AA", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a child; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10AA", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a vulnerable adult; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10AA", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 10AA(2)(d) amended by No. 3/2018 s. 24(3).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "10AA", "sub_path": ["(2)", "(d)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 75, "rect": {"page": 75, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 460.0, "x1": 508.6, "y1": 499.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10AA", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a person arrested on an enforcement warrant issued under the Fines Reform Act 2014.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10AA", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of this section—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10AA", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a person may be considered to be a vulnerable adult or an Aboriginal person if the police officer is of the opinion that the person is such a person; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10AA", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a police officer, in considering whether an arrested person is an Aboriginal person, must have regard to any statement made by the arrested person (whether or not in response to a question asked by the police officer) as to whether they are an Aboriginal person.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10AA", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If bail is refused under section 10(5) for a person to whom this section applies, the police officer must—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10AA", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: endorse on the warrant, file or other papers relating to the arrested person or in any register or record of persons in custody the reasons for refusing bail; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10AA", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: remand the person in custody to appear before a court as soon as practicable within the period of 48 hours after being so remanded; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10AA", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: cause to be produced before the court a copy of the endorsement mentioned in paragraph (a); and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10AA", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: advise the arrested person that they are entitled, should they so wish, to apply for bail when they appear before the court; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10AA", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "e", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: give the person a written statement setting out the provisions of this section and of section 10(5).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10AA", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The police officer must not remand the person in custody under subsection (4)(b) if the police officer considers that it is not practicable for the person to be brought before a court within the next 48 hours (including appearing before it by audio visual link).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10AA", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In the circumstances mentioned in subsection (5) the person must be brought before a bail justice as soon as practicable.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "10AA", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a person remanded in custody under subsection (4)(b) is not brought before a court within 48 hours after being so remanded, the person must be brought before a bail justice as soon as practicable after the expiry of that period of 48 hours.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 11(1) amended by Nos 37/2014 s. 10(Sch. item 8.3), 6/2021 s. 12, 28/2023 s. 75(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "11", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 79, "rect": {"page": 79, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 612.7, "x1": 506.6, "y1": 688.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "11", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Where a person is apprehended for an offence against section 17 of the Summary Offences Act 1966 a police officer of or above the rank of sergeant or for the time being in charge of a police station shall in addition to any power the police officer may have to release such person on bail have power to release the person on the person's making a deposit of such amount not exceeding $50 as the police officer thinks reasonable as security for the payment of any penalty that may be imposed as punishment for the person's offence.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 11(2) amended by Nos 37/2014 s. 10(Sch. item 8.3), 28/2023 s. 75(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "11", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 80, "rect": {"page": 80, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 246.4, "x1": 128.6, "y1": 313.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "11", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Upon releasing a person under this section the police officer shall notify the person that the person is required to appear before a court at a certain time and place and that if the person fails to appear accordingly the charge may be heard in the person's absence and that the deposit will be appropriated to the payment or part payment of any fine that may be imposed by the court and that any surplus thereof will be paid into the Consolidated Fund but that if the person appears to answer to the charge any surplus will be refunded to the person.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 11(3) amended by No. 28/2023 s. 75(3).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "11", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 80, "rect": {"page": 80, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 418.0, "x1": 128.6, "y1": 457.1}, "confidence": "high"}]

text: Every bail undertaking may with the consent of each person offering themselves as a bail guarantor contain a provision for its extension without any further consent of all the bail guarantors upon such postponements or adjournments of the hearing as are from time to time directed, but nothing in this subsection shall prejudice in any way the right of each person offering themselves as a bail guarantor to elect to be bound with respect to a bail undertaking which may be extended only with that person's consent given at the time of the extension and no bail decision maker shall refuse to admit a person to bail on the ground only that a person offering themselves as a bail guarantor has so elected.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 4 substituted.1", "kind": "amendment", "section": "4", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 38, "rect": {"page": 38, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 206.4, "x1": 129.4, "y1": 227.1}, "confidence": "high"}]

text: A person accused of an offence, and being held in custody in relation to that offence, is entitled to be granted bail unless the bail decision maker is required to refuse bail by this Act.

heading: Step 1—exceptional circumstances test
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 4A (Heading) amended by No. 32/2018 s. 85(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "4A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 43, "rect": {"page": 43, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 506.6, "y1": 211.9}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "S. 4A inserted by No. 3/2018 s. 7.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "4A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 43, "rect": {"page": 43, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 215.5, "x1": 502.0, "y1": 254.7}, "confidence": "high"}]

text: This section applies if, under section 4AA(1) or (2), the step 1—exceptional circumstances test applies to a decision of whether to grant bail.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 4A(1A) inserted by No. 32/2018 s. 85(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "4A", "sub_path": ["(1A)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 43, "rect": {"page": 43, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 304.0, "x1": 503.3, "y1": 343.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "4A", "subsection": "1A", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The bail decision maker must refuse bail unless satisfied that exceptional circumstances exist that justify the grant of bail.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "4A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The accused bears the burden of satisfying the bail decision maker as to the existence of exceptional circumstances.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "4A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: In considering whether exceptional circumstances exist, the bail decision maker must take into account the surrounding circumstances.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "4A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The term surrounding circumstances is defined in section 3. Also the bail decision maker is required to take into account other matters if the accused is an Aboriginal person or a child. See sections 3A and 3B.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "4A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the bail decision maker is satisfied that exceptional circumstances exist that justify the grant of bail, the bail decision maker must then move to step 2—unacceptable risk test.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 4AAA inserted by No. 28/2023 s. 9.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "4AAA", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 38, "rect": {"page": 38, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 281.4, "x1": 125.3, "y1": 320.4}, "confidence": "high"}]

{"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "4AAA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 4C(1A) inserted by No. 32/2018 s. 87(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "4C", "sub_path": ["(1A)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 44, "rect": {"page": 44, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 363.4, "x1": 125.3, "y1": 402.5}, "confidence": "high"}]

text: The term surrounding circumstances is defined in section 3. Also the bail decision maker is required to take into account other matters if the accused is an Aboriginal person or a child. See sections 3A and 3B.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "4C", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 5AA(2) amended by No. 26/2017 ss 14(3), 15(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "5AA", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 57, "rect": {"page": 57, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 374.8, "x1": 512.0, "y1": 413.9}, "confidence": "high"}]

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 8(3) inserted by No. 3/2018 s. 11.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "8", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 62, "rect": {"page": 62, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 461.8, "x1": 124.0, "y1": 500.9}, "confidence": "high"}]

heading: Refusal of bail—any offence—insufficient information
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 8A inserted by No. 3/2018 s. 12.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "8A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 65, "rect": {"page": 65, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 502.0, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A bail decision maker may refuse bail for a person accused of any offence if satisfied that it has not been practicable to obtain sufficient information for the purpose of deciding the matter because of the shortness of the period since the commencement of the proceeding for the offence.

heading: Court to make preliminary determination if terrorism risk alleged
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 8AA inserted by No. 32/2018 s. 89.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "8AA", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 63, "rect": {"page": 63, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 218.8, "x1": 503.3, "y1": 257.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8AA", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a court is considering whether to grant bail to a person who is accused of an offence (other than a person arrested on an enforcement warrant issued under the Fines Reform Act 2014); and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the step 1—exceptional circumstances test does not apply to that decision by operation of section 4AA(2)(a), (c) or (d); and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the prosecutor—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: states that the prosecutor has terrorism risk information in respect of the accused; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: alleges that this information shows that there is a risk that the accused will commit a terrorism or foreign incursion offence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a prosecutor makes such an allegation before a bail decision maker other than a court, that bail decision maker cannot grant bail. See sections 10(5AA) and 10A(5AA).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8AA", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: See section 4AA(1) and (2) for when the step 1— exceptional circumstances test applies.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8AA", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Before determining whether to grant bail, the court must determine whether there is a risk that the accused will commit a terrorism or foreign incursion offence.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8AA", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the court determines that there is such a risk, a different step 1 test applies to the decision of whether to grant bail. See section 4AA(2)(b) and (4)(b).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8AA", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: For the purposes of subsection (2), but subject to subsection (4), the court must have regard to any terrorism risk information provided to the court.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8AA", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The court must not have regard to terrorism risk information regarding the accused having, or having had, an association referred to in section 3AAA(1)(n)(i),(ii) or (iii) unless the court is satisfied that the accused knew—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8AA", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that the person or group had expressed support for—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8AA", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the doing of a terrorist act; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8AA", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a terrorist organisation; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8AA", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "iii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the provision of resources to a terrorist organisation; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8AA", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that the person or group was directly or indirectly engaged in, preparing for, planning, assisting in or fostering the doing of a terrorist act; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8AA", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that the group was a terrorist organisation.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8AA", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Nothing in this section prevents the court from considering, under section 4E, whether there is an unacceptable risk an accused would, if released on bail, commit a terrorism or foreign incursion offence.

heading: Refusal of bail—offence involving serious injury— uncertainty as to death or recovery
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 8B inserted by No. 3/2018 s. 12.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "8B", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 65, "rect": {"page": 65, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 280.0, "x1": 502.0, "y1": 319.1}, "confidence": "high"}]

{"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8B", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: This section applies in relation to an application for bail made by or on behalf of a person accused of an offence of causing injury to another person.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "8B", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A bail decision maker may refuse bail if at the time of deciding the application it is uncertain whether the person injured will die or recover from the injury.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 17D inserted by No. 32/2024 s. 903.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "17D", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 95, "rect": {"page": 95, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 368.9, "x1": 503.3, "y1": 408.0}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17D", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17D", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A decision—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17D", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17D", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: of whether to vary the conditions of bail—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17D", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17D", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The criteria are—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17D", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17D", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17D", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the Children's Court sitting at a venue that is in a prescribed region of the State; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17D", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the Supreme Court; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17D", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that the additional prescribed criteria (if any) are met; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17D", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: that the decision is to be made before the second anniversary of the commencement of this Part.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17D", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17D", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17D", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Additionally, the accused is of an eligible age if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17D", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17D", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the accused was under 18 years of age at the time of the alleged offending.

heading: What are Part 2A conditions?
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 17E (Heading) amended by No. 34/2025 s. 16(4).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "17E", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 96, "rect": {"page": 96, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 365.2, "x1": 128.6, "y1": 413.4}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "S. 17E inserted by No. 32/2024 s. 903.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "17E", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 96, "rect": {"page": 96, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 417.1, "x1": 125.3, "y1": 456.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17E", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 17E(1) amended by No. 34/2025 s. 16(5)(a).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "17E", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 96, "rect": {"page": 96, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 464.2, "x1": 128.6, "y1": 503.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17E", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The following conditions imposed in respect of a grant of bail are the Part 2A conditions—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17E", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a condition that the accused must for 24 hours of each day wear an electronic monitoring device fitted to the accused at the direction of the Secretary; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17E", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a condition that the accused must not, without reasonable excuse, tamper with, damage, disable or remove any electronic monitoring device or equipment used for the electronic monitoring; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17E", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: a condition that the accused must comply with any direction given by the Secretary, that is necessary for the Secretary to give, to ensure that the accused is electronically monitored.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 17E(2) amended by No. 34/2025 s. 16(5)(b).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "17E", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 97, "rect": {"page": 97, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 191.2, "x1": 506.6, "y1": 230.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17E", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A reference in this Part to an accused who is subject to Part 2A conditions is a reference to an accused on bail in respect of whom the Part 2A conditions have been imposed.

heading: What is a suitability report?
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 17F inserted by No. 32/2024 s. 903.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "17F", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 97, "rect": {"page": 97, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 252.4, "x1": 503.3, "y1": 291.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17F", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

{"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17F", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A suitability report is a report the Secretary causes to be prepared that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17F", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17F", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17F", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17F", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: whether there are adequate resources and equipment to enable the accused to be electronically monitored on bail; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17F", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17F", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: includes the prescribed material (if any).

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "1", "subdivision": null, "section": "17F", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Nothing in this section prevents the inclusion of any other material in a suitability report.

heading: When bail decision maker may impose Part 2A conditions
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 17G (Heading) amended by No. 34/2025 s. 16(6).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "17G", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 98, "rect": {"page": 98, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 201.7, "x1": 128.6, "y1": 250.1}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "S. 17G inserted by No. 32/2024 s. 903, amended by No. 34/2025 s. 16(7).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "17G", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 98, "rect": {"page": 98, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 253.8, "x1": 128.6, "y1": 320.4}, "confidence": "high"}]

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "17G", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 17G(b) amended by No. 34/2025 s. 16(7).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "17G", "sub_path": ["(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 98, "rect": {"page": 98, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 349.9, "x1": 128.6, "y1": 389.1}, "confidence": "high"}]

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "17G", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "2A", "division": "2", "subdivision": null, "section": "17G", "subsection": null, "paragraph": "d", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

text: Despite subsection (1)(a), a person referred to in paragraph (c) of the definition of authorised officer in subsection (6) may remove an electronic monitoring device or equipment used for electronic monitoring only on a direction given by the Secretary.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 17M inserted by No. 32/2024 s. 903.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "17M", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 103, "rect": {"page": 103, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 479.8, "x1": 503.3, "y1": 518.9}, "confidence": "high"}]

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 18A (Heading) inserted by No. 70/2010 s. 17(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "18A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 116, "rect": {"page": 116, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 207.7, "x1": 125.3, "y1": 256.1}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "S. 18A inserted by No. 9690 s. 4.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "18A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 116, "rect": {"page": 116, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 256.8, "x1": 130.5, "y1": 286.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "18A", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 18A(1) amended by Nos 9902 s. 2(1)(Sch. item 2), 10087 s. 3(1)(Sch. 1 item 5), 57/1989 s. 4(1)(d)(i), substituted by No. 70/2010 s. 17(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "18A", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 116, "rect": {"page": 116, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 300.7, "x1": 134.6, "y1": 413.4}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "18A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a person is granted bail, the Director of Public Prosecutions may appeal to the Supreme Court against the order granting bail if—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "18A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the Director is satisfied that—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "18A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the conditions of bail are insufficient; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "18A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the decision to grant bail contravenes this Act; and

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "18A", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: the Director is satisfied that it is in the public interest to do so.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "18A", "subsection": "10", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On the hearing and determination of an appeal under this section no costs shall be allowed on either side.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 18A(11) amended by No. 28/2023 s. 80(6).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "18A", "sub_path": ["(11)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 118, "rect": {"page": 118, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 238.6, "x1": 128.6, "y1": 277.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "18A", "subsection": "11", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A respondent is entitled to be present on the hearing of an appeal under this section notwithstanding that the respondent may be in custody but the Court may make any order under this section where the respondent is for any reason not present.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 18A(12) inserted by No. 70/2010 s. 17(6).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "18A", "sub_path": ["(12)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 118, "rect": {"page": 118, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 327.4, "x1": 125.3, "y1": 366.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "18A", "subsection": "12", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The respondent or the Director of Public Prosecutions may appeal to the Court of Appeal from a decision of a single judge of the Supreme Court made under this section.

history_json: [{"raw": "Note to s. 18A inserted by No. 70/2010 s. 17(6).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "18A", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": "note", "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 118, "rect": {"page": 118, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 388.6, "x1": 133.3, "y1": 427.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "18A", "subsection": "12", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Sections 18AG and 24(4) also provide for certain appeals.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 18A(2) amended by Nos 10084 s. 18(2), 57/1989 s. 4(1)(d)(ii), 28/2023 ss 55(1), 80(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "18A", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 116, "rect": {"page": 116, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 468.7, "x1": 134.0, "y1": 544.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "18A", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Where the Director of Public Prosecutions desires to appeal to the Court under subsection (1) the Director shall cause notice of appeal setting forth the grounds thereof to be given to the person granted bail (hereafter in this section called the respondent) and to each bail guarantor (if any).

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 18A(3) amended by Nos 6/2018 s. 68(Sch. 2 item 13.8), 28/2023 s. 55(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "18A", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 116, "rect": {"page": 116, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 557.5, "x1": 128.6, "y1": 624.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "18A", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A notice required to be given to a bail guarantor under subsection (2) may be given personally or by post or by causing the notice to be delivered at the place of residence of the respondent or bail guarantor (as the case requires) shown in the affidavit of justification for bail.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 18A(4) amended by No. 57/1989 s. 4(1)(d)(iii).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "18A", "sub_path": ["(4)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 117, "rect": {"page": 117, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 506.6, "y1": 202.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "18A", "subsection": "4", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Notice of appeal shall not be given under subsection (1) more than one month after the bail is granted without first obtaining the leave of the Supreme Court.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 18A(5) amended by Nos 10084 s. 18(2), 35/1996 s. 453(Sch. 1 item 8.3), 25/2023 s. 7(Sch. 1 item 4.1), 28/2023 ss 55(3), 80(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "18A", "sub_path": ["(5)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 117, "rect": {"page": 117, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 218.8, "x1": 512.0, "y1": 331.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "18A", "subsection": "5", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: The Director of Public Prosecutions or a legal practitioner on the Director's behalf may appear on behalf of His Majesty on any appeal under this section and any respondent or bail guarantor to whom notice is given under subsection (3) may appear in person or by a legal practitioner.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 18A(6) amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 11.18), substituted by No. 70/2010 s. 17(3).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "18A", "sub_path": ["(6)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 117, "rect": {"page": 117, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 347.2, "x1": 512.6, "y1": 423.0}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "18A", "subsection": "6", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On an appeal under this section, if the Supreme Court thinks that a different order should have been made, the Supreme Court must set aside the order that is the subject of the appeal and, without limiting the powers of the Supreme Court with respect to bail, conduct a fresh hearing in relation to the grant of bail to the respondent.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 18A(7) amended by Nos 57/1989 s. 4(1)(d)(iv), 28/2023 s. 80(3).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "18A", "sub_path": ["(7)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 117, "rect": {"page": 117, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 449.8, "x1": 507.3, "y1": 507.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "18A", "subsection": "7", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the respondent is not present in Court when an order granting bail is revoked or varied under this section the Court shall cause a warrant to be issued for apprehending the respondent and bringing the respondent before the Court.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 18A(8) amended by Nos 57/1989 s. 4(1)(d)(v), 70/2010 s. 17(4), 28/2023 s. 80(4).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "18A", "sub_path": ["(8)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 117, "rect": {"page": 117, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 524.8, "x1": 507.3, "y1": 600.6}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "18A", "subsection": "8", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Court revokes an order granting the respondent bail the Court shall remand the respondent in custody to await trial.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 18A(9) amended by Nos 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 11.19), 70/2010 s. 17(5), 28/2023 ss 55(4), 80(5).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "18A", "sub_path": ["(9)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 117, "rect": {"page": 117, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 611.8, "x1": 512.0, "y1": 696.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "4", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "18A", "subsection": "9", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If the Court makes an order varying the amount or conditions of bail the Court shall require the respondent to find another bail guarantor or further or other securities for the attendance of the respondent and may remand the respondent in custody until another bail guarantee or further or other security is provided.

heading: Arrest on another charge not to vacate bail
history_json: [{"raw": "No. 8731 s. 35.", "kind": "provenance", "section": null, "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 119, "rect": {"page": 119, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 207.9, "x1": 512.5, "y1": 219.4}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-10-06T03:19:10.118828+00:00"}]

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 19(1) amended by Nos 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. items 11.1, 11.20), 28/2023 ss 56(1), 81(1), 101.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "19", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 119, "rect": {"page": 119, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 227.5, "x1": 512.0, "y1": 312.6}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "19", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Where an accused is on bail to attend before a court the accused's arrest on another charge shall not vacate the bail undertaking which shall continue to bind the accused and each bail guarantor (if any) until the accused is discharged or sentenced in respect of the offence to which the bail relates.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 19(2) amended by Nos 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 11.21), 70/2010 s. 19(1), 28/2023 ss 56(2), 81(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "19", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 119, "rect": {"page": 119, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 330.1, "x1": 512.0, "y1": 415.2}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "19", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in subsection (1) where a person arrested on another charge is on bail to attend before a court the court may remand the person in custody or may require the person to furnish new or additional bail guarantees.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 19(3) amended by Nos 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. items 11.1, 11.22), 70/2010 s. 19(2), 28/2023 s. 56(3).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "19", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 119, "rect": {"page": 119, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 418.9, "x1": 506.6, "y1": 513.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "19", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an accused who is on bail to attend for trial is remanded in custody pursuant to the provisions of subsection (2) each bail guarantor (if any) is discharged.

heading: Death of bail guarantor
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 20 (Heading) inserted by No. 28/2023 s. 57(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "20", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 119, "rect": {"page": 119, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 535.0, "x1": 503.3, "y1": 583.2}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "S. 20 amended by Nos 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 11.1), 28/2023 ss 57(2), 82.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "20", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 119, "rect": {"page": 119, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 583.9, "x1": 506.6, "y1": 650.7}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "No. 8731 s. 36.", "kind": "provenance", "section": null, "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 119, "rect": {"page": 119, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 519.7, "x1": 512.5, "y1": 531.3}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-10-06T03:19:12.899313+00:00"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "20", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Where a bail guarantor dies before the bail is forfeited the bail guarantor's estate shall not be subject to any liability in respect of the bail but the accused may be required to find another bail guarantor.

heading: Abolition of right of a bail guarantor to apprehend a principal
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 21 (Heading) amended by No. 28/2023 s. 58(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "21", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 120, "rect": {"page": 120, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 128.6, "y1": 211.9}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "S. 21 amended by Nos 51/1989 s. 142(p)(q), 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 11.23), substituted by No. 70/2010 s. 20, amended by No. 28/2023 ss 58(2), 83.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "21", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 120, "rect": {"page": 120, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 215.5, "x1": 134.6, "y1": 337.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "21", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 23 (Heading) inserted by No. 28/2023 s. 59(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "23", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 120, "rect": {"page": 120, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 471.5, "x1": 125.3, "y1": 519.9}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "No. 8731 s. 39.", "kind": "provenance", "section": null, "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 120, "rect": {"page": 120, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 456.4, "x1": 134.5, "y1": 467.9}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-10-06T03:19:20.386956+00:00"}]

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 23(1) amended by Nos 9158 s. 5, 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 11.25), 28/2023 ss 59(2), 84(1), 102(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "23", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 120, "rect": {"page": 120, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 535.6, "x1": 134.0, "y1": 620.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "23", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If an accused is released on bail with a bail guarantee, a bail guarantor may at any time apply to the court to which the accused would be required to surrender under the bail undertaking to discharge the applicant from liability with respect to the bail undertaking.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 23(2) amended by Nos 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 11.25(c)), 28/2023 s. 84(2).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "23", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 120, "rect": {"page": 120, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 624.4, "x1": 132.8, "y1": 691.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "23", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On an application being made under subsection (1) the court shall issue a warrant for apprehending the accused and bringing the accused before the court.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 23(3) amended by Nos 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 11.25 (a)(c)), 28/2023 s. 84(3).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "23", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 121, "rect": {"page": 121, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 512.5, "y1": 230.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "23", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: On the attendance of the accused before the court the court may direct the applicant to be discharged from liability with respect to the undertaking.

text: If the court discharges a bail guarantor from liability with respect to a bail undertaking the court shall require the accused to find another bail guarantor or other security for the accused's attendance and may remand the accused in custody until another bail guarantor or further security is provided.

heading: Arrest of person released on bail
history_json: [{"raw": "No. 8731 s. 40.", "kind": "provenance", "section": null, "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 121, "rect": {"page": 121, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 347.2, "x1": 512.5, "y1": 358.7}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-10-06T03:19:24.441466+00:00"}]
