history_json: [{"raw": "S. 24(1) amended by Nos 43/2011 s. 6(1), 37/2014 s. 10(Sch. item 8.4(a)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "24", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 121, "rect": {"page": 121, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 367.0, "x1": 506.6, "y1": 433.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "24", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Any police officer, or any protective services officer on duty at a designated place, may without warrant arrest any person who has been released on bail—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 24(1)(a) amended by Nos 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 11.26), 43/2011 s. 6(2), 37/2014 s. 10(Sch. item 8.4(a)), 28/2023 s. 103(1)(a).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "24", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(a)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 121, "rect": {"page": 121, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 448.0, "x1": 506.6, "y1": 560.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "24", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the police officer or protective services officer has reasonable grounds for believing that the person is likely to breach the bail undertaking or any condition of bail, or has reasonable cause to suspect that the person is breaching or has breached any such condition;

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 24(1)(b) amended by Nos 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 11.26), 43/2011 s. 6(2), 37/2014 s. 10(Sch. item 8.4(a)), 28/2023 ss 60(1)(a), 103(1)(b).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "24", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(b)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 121, "rect": {"page": 121, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 570.4, "x1": 506.6, "y1": 692.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "24", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the police officer or protective services officer is notified in writing by any of the person's bail guarantors that the bail guarantor believes that the person is likely to breach the bail undertaking and for that reason the bail guarantor wishes to be relieved of his obligations as a bail guarantor; or

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 24(1)(c) amended by Nos 43/2011 s. 6(2), 37/2014 s. 10(Sch. item 8.4(a)), 28/2023 s. 60(1)(b).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "24", "sub_path": ["(1)", "(c)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 122, "rect": {"page": 122, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 128.6, "y1": 248.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "24", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": "c", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the police officer or protective services officer has reasonable grounds for believing that any of the person's bail guarantors are dead, or that for any other reason the security is no longer sufficient.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 24(1A) inserted by No. 43/2011 s. 6(3), amended by No. 37/2014 s. 10(Sch. item 8.4(a)).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "24", "sub_path": ["(1A)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 122, "rect": {"page": 122, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 252.4, "x1": 128.6, "y1": 328.2}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "24", "subsection": "1A", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a protective services officer arrests a person under subsection (1), the protective services officer must hand the person into the custody of a police officer as soon as practicable after the person is arrested.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 24(1B) inserted by No. 45/2017 s. 50.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "24", "sub_path": ["(1B)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 122, "rect": {"page": 122, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 347.2, "x1": 125.3, "y1": 386.3}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "24", "subsection": "1B", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: A protective services officer may only exercise the power to arrest without warrant under this section in relation to a person who is at, or in the vicinity of, a designated place.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 24(2) amended by Nos 51/1989 s. 142(r), 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 11.27), substituted by No. 43/2011 s. 6(4), amended by Nos 37/2014 s. 10(Sch. item 8.4(a)), 28/2023 s. 103(2), substituted by No. 8/2025 s. 6.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "24", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 122, "rect": {"page": 122, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 408.4, "x1": 134.6, "y1": 585.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "24", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: If a person is arrested under subsection (1) or is handed into the custody of a police officer under subsection (1A), a police officer must deal with the person as follows—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "24", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the person was arrested or handed into custody within 24 hours before the time at which the person is bound by the bail undertaking to attend before a court, a police officer must bring the person before that court at that time; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "24", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the person was not arrested or handed into custody within the period described in paragraph (a), a police officer must, as soon as practicable (and in any event within 24 hours) bring the person before—

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "24", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if it is then within ordinary court sitting hours, a court; or

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "24", "subsection": "2", "paragraph": "b", "subparagraph": "ii", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if it is then outside ordinary court sitting hours, a bail justice.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 24(3) amended by Nos 51/1989 s. 142(s), 28/2023 s. 103(3)(a).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "24", "sub_path": ["(3)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 123, "rect": {"page": 123, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 163.6, "x1": 507.3, "y1": 221.1}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "24", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Where a person who is on bail is brought before a bail justice or court pursuant to the provisions of paragraph (a) or paragraph (b) of subsection (2) the bail justice or court—

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 24(3)(a) substituted by No. 84/1997 s. 8(1), amended by Nos 70/2010 s. 22(1)(a), 28/2023 ss 60(2), 85(a)(ii), 103(3)(b)(i), 32/2024 s. 905(2). 3", "kind": "amendment", "section": "24", "sub_path": ["(3)", "(a)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 123, "rect": {"page": 123, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 238.6, "x1": 512.6, "y1": 360.5}, "confidence": "high"}]

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 24(3)(a)(i) amended by Nos 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 11.28), 28/2023 s. 103(3)(b)(ii).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "24", "sub_path": ["(3)", "(a)", "(i)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 123, "rect": {"page": 123, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 367.0, "x1": 510.6, "y1": 433.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "24", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": "i", "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: if the direction is given by a court, that the person be brought before the court at the time when the person is required by the bail undertaking to attend; or

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 24(3)(a)(ii) substituted by No. 70/2010 s. 22(1)(b), amended by No. 28/2023 s. 85(a)(i).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "24", "sub_path": ["(3)", "(a)", "(ii)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 123, "rect": {"page": 123, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 448.0, "x1": 512.6, "y1": 514.7}, "confidence": "high"}]

text: if not of that opinion—shall release the person on the original bail undertaking.

path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "24", "subsection": "3", "paragraph": "a", "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}

heading: Arrest for imposing additional conditions
history_json: [{"raw": "S. 25 amended by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 11.29).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "25", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 124, "rect": {"page": 124, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 618.5, "x1": 128.6, "y1": 666.9}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "25", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Where a court is of opinion that it is necessary or advisable in the interests of justice that the conditions of bail of any person should be amended or supplemented, the court may issue a warrant for the apprehension of the accused and may, when the accused is brought before the court amend or supplement the conditions as the court thinks fit.

heading: Arrest where bail insufficient
history_json: [{"raw": "No. 8731 s. 42.", "kind": "provenance", "section": null, "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 125, "rect": {"page": 125, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 205.0, "x1": 512.5, "y1": 216.5}, "confidence": "manual", "linked_at": "2026-10-06T03:46:08.105794+00:00"}]

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 26(1) amended by Nos 70/2010 s. 23, 26/2017 s. 14(16), 28/2023 ss 86(1), 116.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "26", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 125, "rect": {"page": 125, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 224.8, "x1": 509.0, "y1": 291.5}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "26", "subsection": "1", "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Where the bail decision maker by whom or which a person was admitted to bail is of opinion that the person was released with insufficient security or with security which has become insufficient the bail decision maker by which the person was granted bail may issue a warrant for the person's apprehension directing that the person be brought before a court and may order the person to find sufficient security and, if the person fails to do so, may remand the person in custody.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 26(2) amended by Nos 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 11.30), 28/2023 ss 86(2), 104.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "26", "sub_path": ["(2)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 125, "rect": {"page": 125, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 368.8, "x1": 507.7, "y1": 435.5}, "confidence": "high"}]

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 27(1) amended by Nos 37/2014 s. 10(Sch. item 8.5), 26/2017 s. 14(17), 28/2023 s. 105(1).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "27", "sub_path": ["(1)"], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 125, "rect": {"page": 125, "x0": 462.6, "y0": 556.6, "x1": 506.6, "y1": 641.7}, "confidence": "high"}]

text: Where the conditions of bail have been fixed the bail undertaking (and the required bail guarantees, if any) need not be given before the bail decision maker granting the bail but may be given before any court or before a bail justice or a court official or before a police officer of or above the rank of sergeant or for the time being in charge of a police station or, where any of the parties is in prison, before the governor of the prison or any prison officer thereat of or above the rank of senior prison officer and thereupon all the consequences of law shall ensue as if the bail undertaking and the bail guarantees, if any, had been given before the bail decision maker granting the bail.

history_json: [{"raw": "S. 32 (Heading) inserted by No. 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 11.38).", "kind": "amendment", "section": "32", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 130, "rect": {"page": 130, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 260.2, "x1": 125.3, "y1": 317.7}, "confidence": "high"}, {"raw": "S. 32 amended by Nos 68/2009 s. 97(Sch. item 11.39), 25/2023 s. 7(Sch. 1 item 4.2), 28/2023 ss 62, 89, 107.", "kind": "amendment", "section": "32", "sub_path": [], "target_kind": null, "target_id": null, "schedule": null, "chapter": null, "division": null, "part": null, "def_name": null, "page": 130, "rect": {"page": 130, "x0": 84.6, "y0": 318.4, "x1": 133.3, "y1": 412.7}, "confidence": "high"}]
path_json: {"schedule": null, "chapter": null, "part": "5", "division": null, "subdivision": null, "section": "32", "subsection": null, "paragraph": null, "subparagraph": null, "sub_subparagraph": null, "definition": null}
text: Where a deposit of money or other security is made as a condition of bail declared to be forfeited because of the failure of the person released to attend in accordance with the person's bail undertaking the deposit becomes forfeited to His Majesty but the person bailed shall have the same right as a bail guarantor has under section 6 of the Crown Proceedings Act 1958 to apply for an order varying or rescinding the forfeiture and for that purpose the provisions of the said section 6 shall, so far as those provisions are applicable and with such modifications as are necessary, apply with respect to forfeited deposits of bail and in particular with the modification that any reference in those provisions to a bail guarantor shall be read and construed as a reference to the person bailed.
